forbidden_reads: any benchmark query or ground truth
any ignored or untracked prior A4 artifact

scalar_histogram_dp.reason: no maintained pinned curve-producing native 1D DP implementation satisfying the frozen histogram/tie interface was found locally

generator.integer_arithmetic: uint64 modulo 2^64 for hash expressions; signed int64 for label/noise/numerator after residues are reduced to their stated small ranges
generator.splitmix64: z=x+0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; z=(z xor (z>>30))*0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9; z=(z xor (z>>27))*0x94D049BB133111EB; return z xor (z>>31); wrap after every add/multiply
generator.base: seed xor ((row_id+1)*row_multiplier) xor ((coordinate_id+1)*coordinate_multiplier), with uint64 wrap
generator.label: hash1 mod states

tiny_exact_suite.exhaustive_cases: case_id increasing; support_size=1..4; lexicographic combinations of (-2,-1,0,1,2); lexicographic Cartesian weights in (1,2,3)^support_size; vector_ids=0..support_size-1; maximum_cardinality=support_size; exactly 780 cases
tiny_exact_suite.generated_case_rule: for suite_index i=0..255 set size=1+(i mod 12); for j=0..size-1 set base=seed xor ((i+1)*row_multiplier) xor ((j+1)*coordinate_multiplier), value=-32+(splitmix64(base) mod 65), weight=1+(splitmix64(base xor second_stream_xor) mod 8), vector_id=j; draw/order is i then j; maximum_cardinality=min(8,distinct values after aggregation)
tiny_exact_suite.bit_pattern_case_rule: case_ids 780..787 in listed order; values are the listed raw binary32 words, weights follow the separator, vector_ids are 0..size-1, maximum_cardinality is the count of distinct decoded values after signed-zero canonicalization
tiny_exact_suite.case_order: 780 exhaustive, then 8 bit-pattern cases in listed order, then 256 generated cases
tiny_exact_suite.reference: independent bounded exhaustive contiguous-partition enumeration using signed __int128 integer moments

arms.D: same histogram curves; K1,K2 powers of two; K1*K2<=2^B
arms.A: same histogram curves; positive integer K1,K2; K1*K2<=2^B; u=z1+K1*z2

P.training_surface: for each subspace instantiate Faiss Clustering with the frozen fields and seed, run eight redos, write the winning float32 centers into a Faiss ProductQuantizer, and encode with that ProductQuantizer; do not call a hidden/default second trainer
P.empty_cluster: if any Faiss iteration stat nsplit is nonzero, CONTROL_INVALID

V.start_0: candidate A binary32-serialized then binary64-decoded Cartesian centers in mixed-radix order; if used_states<S, repeatedly append the raw row maximizing distance to its nearest current center, ties choose smallest row_id
V.starts_1_to_7: empty initial centroid array; Faiss Clustering initialization with the frozen per-start seed
V.empty_cluster: if any Faiss iteration stat nsplit is nonzero, CONTROL_INVALID
V.winner: lowest final direct-replay fitting SSE; ties choose smaller redo_id

DEPENDENCY_OR_BUILD_INVALID: CMake option or BLAS identity mismatch
APPROXIMATION_SENSITIVE: H1024 versus H2048 changes any registered contrast sign or admission decision
NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED: any within-envelope allocation changes the decision
MEMORY_CEILING_FAIL: any arm peak RSS exceeds ceiling
SUPPORT_OVERHEAD_FAIL: median support/scientific CPU ratio exceeds ceiling
NO_GO_REOPENING_COST: median A-specific/shared-scalar CPU ratio exceeds ceiling

output.format: contract_copy is byte-identical to committed source; the other four files are canonical_JSON_UTF8_LF_sorted_keys_no_nan_no_infinity
output.numeric_encoding: scientific binary32/binary64 values are lowercase C++ std::hexfloat strings; durations and byte counts are unsigned decimal JSON integers; booleans are JSON booleans
output.schema_policy: each non-contract output is one JSON object whose top-level key set is exactly the listed set; no additional top-level keys; named arrays contain objects with exactly the fields stated in their description

contract_copy.json: byte-for-byte copy of this committed contract; no added keys
timing_repetitions.json: repetitions array with per-arm scientific_cpu_us, wall_us, support_cpu_us, peak_rss_bytes, shared_scalar_cpu_us, A_specific_cpu_us

output.contract_identity: contract_copy.json must be byte-identical to the committed machine contract; every other file repeats its SHA-256
